status: frozen before terminal V19X4 or V19BM products, any observed I4 or I5 score, lensing, halos, action derivation, gravity fitting, or holdout access
purpose: Execute the already frozen V19BL I4/I5 source-only decision on every cluster, temperature-normalization correlation branch, smoothing scale and aperture, with an explicit separation between the directional I4 requirement and the scalar amplitude requirement.

registered_inputs.stellar_control: within-cluster, within-draw stellar-light percentile rank paired by equal sample_id

variants.primary_choice_reason: Use the least-smoothed preregistered field at the preregistered primary aperture to retain the most measured source topology; all other five variants remain mandatory simultaneous stability tests and cannot be dropped.

decision_rule.amplitude_requirement: After I4 direction passes every cluster and correlation branch, require either I4 amplitude or I5 scalar activation to pass every cluster and branch.
decision_rule.variant_requirement: Every core gate passes separately in all six scale-radius variants and at least 90 percent of draws remain within the frozen primary-to-all-variants tolerance.
decision_rule.correlation_requirement: Every decision must pass rho=-0.9, 0.0 and +0.9; branches are robustness alternatives and are never averaged.
decision_rule.failure_action: If the gate fails, do not open lensing or invent an action. Record which source component failed and obtain direct gas velocities or a preregistered independent merger sample.

execution.preserve_region_outputs: q16, median and q84 of candidate components and all five density-control predictors plus support masks

outputs.branch_products: one hash-bound source-only NPZ per cluster and rank-correlation branch

claim_boundary: V19BP can identify a robust projected baryonic source state; it does not establish that gravity or lensing follows that state.
I4 supplies a projected 2D axial tensor, not a full 3D stress; I5 is scalar and can never substitute for the required direction.
A pass authorizes deriving the least-field-content covariant action from the source result. It does not authorize fitting that action to lensing or galaxy targets.
The two development clusters can reject a source candidate but cannot establish population universality.
No lensing, halo, galaxy rotation, action placement, coupling, wavelength, gravity constant or holdout enters this score.
